name: dashboard
label: Dashboard Table
description: Dashboard table for enabling state filtering, time dimension statistics, and other reporting scenarios related to dashboard.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: fcd
fields.description: Creation time. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: fcu
fields.description: Creator. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the ID field, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: idx_fcd
indexes.description: Standard index covering the fcd field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: idx_fcu
indexes.description: Standard index covering the fcu field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.
